description.zh-CN: 纯白背景、商品居中，适合各平台主图；保留原商品像素。亚马逊平台只抠图放到纯白背景上，不调用生成模型。
description.en: Pure white background with the product centered, for main images on any platform; keeps the original product pixels. For Amazon the cut-out is simply placed on pure white without any generation model.

prompt.prefix: professional e-commerce studio shot on a pure white seamless background,
prompt.suffix: evenly lit, soft natural shadow, centered composition, high detail
prompt.negative: text, watermark, logo overlay, props, product, bottle, jar, box, packaging, container, colored background, busy background
